name: x
description: Search, read, and organize X through X's official MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Search posts, timelines, trends, news, and bookmarks on X.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to X's official MCP server (api.x.com/mcp) with your own X account. Search the full post archive, read user timelines and threads, scan trends and news, and capture or organize bookmarks with folders. Read-and-bookmark by design: the connection never requests posting permissions.
defaultPrompt: What is X saying about {topic} today?
